executiveSummary.headline: Make the Hotel-Theater Proposition and Central-Madrid Assets Easier to Resolve
executiveSummary.lead: UMusic Hotel Madrid has a distinctive official proposition—130 rooms, direct access to the 898-seat Teatro Albéniz, four meeting rooms, central walkability, and seasonal rooftop amenities—but appeared in only 2 of 46 eligible scenarios. The action plan focuses on precise hotel-theater packaging, seasonal amenity clarity, planner facts, and small official-page hygiene issues.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 184 comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of 46 eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. No certified peer position is available. Reality Gap summarizes tested attribute recognition and does not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: The Signature Hotel-Theater Offer Is Specific but Lightly Captured
themes.what: The official site documents direct lobby access to the 898-seat Teatro Albéniz and a 130-room five-star hotel, while scenario presence was 4.3%.
themes.whyItMatters: The opportunity is to package verified decision context, not to promise ranking movement.

themes.title: Central and Rooftop Assets Are Under-Recognized
themes.what: Walkable downtown was recognized at 7.1%, outdoor pool 10%, fitness 14.3%, city views 20%, and terrace rooms 5.7%.
themes.whyItMatters: Official pages already support these attributes but need consistent seasonal and location qualifiers.

themes.title: Small Official-Page Errors Weaken Precision
themes.what: The theater page repeats “TEATRP” in event addresses, and a 2026 Splash Pass remains under a 2025 URL slug.
themes.whyItMatters: Simple hygiene fixes reduce ambiguity in otherwise strong first-party content.

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: Priority pages present one coherent 130-room hotel plus 898-seat theater proposition; seasonal rooftop and pool facts are consistently qualified; meeting-room facts have a planner-ready source; and named URL/text hygiene issues are corrected.
executiveSummary.closing: The hotel does not need generic destination copy. It needs a precise, cross-linked explanation of what is unusually ownable: a five-star stay inside Madrid's live cultural fabric.

methodology.scope: Combines the pinned certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, ADP remeasurement, production write, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital, brand, and partner teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying ranking, booking, ADR, or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked later. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, ADR, or revenue.
methodology.nextStep: Approve the highest-priority source-of-truth decision, then authorize only the validated work.

strongestFindings: Only 4.3% scenario presence despite a highly specific official hotel-theater proposition in central Madrid.
Walkable downtown, outdoor pool, fitness, city views, and terrace rooms are all under-recognized despite explicit official content.
The official theater page repeats “TEATRP” in event addresses, and a 2026 Splash Pass sits under a 2025 URL slug.
